scope: JSDOM controller behavior with deterministic mocked HTTP mutations and actual backend-generated read fixtures plus an optional source-generated Transformers catalog. Generic model observations are synthetic display fixtures. If llama_job_sha256 or component_job_sha256 is present, its visual regression consumes that actual execution receipt; computation is not rerun by this DOM suite. This does not test browser rendering, pointer hit-testing, real training, HTTP server integration, or V8 sandbox execution.
